planted.text: Late entry, date correction: the new evening confusion recorded on Nov 15, 2026 actually occurred on Jul 11, 2026, before Karissa's last IDT review, and was discussed at that meeting. It is not a new event for this review period.

headline: Karissa had a fall at home on Sep 23, 2026 and an ED visit for dehydration and dizziness on Nov 5, 2026. PT found gait unsteady with a Timed Up and Go of 19 seconds.

items.statement: On Sep 23, 2026 Karissa fell in the bathroom at night, and her son Marcus found her on the floor. She denied head strike or loss of consciousness, and no injury was noted. Fall risk was reassessed as high and a PT referral was placed.
items.verifier_note: Every detail matches the Sep 23 nursing note: bathroom fall at night, son Marcus found her, no head strike or LOC, no injury, fall risk high, PT referral.

items.statement: She was seen in the partner hospital ED on Nov 5, 2026 for dehydration and dizziness. She was treated and released the same day with no new medications. The PCP follow-up on Nov 11 found her back to baseline per her son, and the plan was to monitor closely over the next two weeks.
items.verifier_note: The ED note and encounter record support the Nov 5 visit, the reason, same-day release and no new medications. The Nov 11 PCP note supports back to baseline per her son and close monitoring over two weeks.

items.statement: The PT evaluation on Oct 1, 2026 found gait slow and unsteady with intermittent cane use, and Timed Up and Go was 19 seconds. PT recommended a front-wheeled walker, a home safety evaluation and bathroom grab bars. PT will see her twice weekly for strength and balance.
items.verifier_note: The Oct 1 PT note matches every detail: gait findings, TUG 19 seconds, the walker, home safety evaluation and grab bars recommendations, and twice-weekly sessions.

questions: Have the front-wheeled walker, home safety evaluation and bathroom grab bars been completed? The notes don't show this.
What came of the two-week monitoring after the Nov 11 PCP visit? No outcome is documented in the notes provided.
Is there a link between the Sep 23 night-time fall and the Nov 5 dizziness and dehydration? Should the team look at hydration and night-time toileting?
How is Karissa progressing with twice-weekly PT, and is a repeat Timed Up and Go due?
